title: Match the complete string with zero-or-more wildcards
goal: Repair wildcard_match(text, pattern), both strings. Return a bool indicating whether the entire text matches the entire pattern. '?' matches exactly one character; '*' matches any sequence of zero or more characters, including whitespace and newlines. All other pattern characters are literal, including dots, brackets, and backslashes. There is no escape syntax, so a backslash does not disable a following wildcard. Characters follow Python string indexing, including Unicode. Consecutive stars are allowed. Empty text matches an empty pattern or a pattern consisting only of stars; an empty pattern matches no nonempty text. Do not mutate inputs and preserve the signature.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep wildcard_match and its signature unchanged.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct inputs exercising the same stated specification
